title: An HBS student: ‘The comments Eric made captured the type of company I want to build’
summary: A student in the class put a question to Eric about how to structure a young company. Their own startup is a few weeks into reworking its arrangements with a lawyer, so the answer landed on work already underway.
attribution_title: Launching Tech Ventures, Harvard Business School · shared anonymously by the course faculty
blockquote: Thank you for giving me the opportunity to ask Eric Ries a question about governance for early-stage startups. I thought today was an amazing class. The comments Eric made captured the type of company I want to build. We have been reviewing our governance structure for the last few weeks, and we have been working with a lawyer to finalize the details.
blockquote_source: A student in the class, relayed anonymously by the course faculty
